ransomware_association.interpretation: Unknown means no confirmed association in the available data, not absence of risk.

temporal_urgency.reason: Historical remediation deadlines are not evidence of current unpatched status.

weighting_method: Available component weights are renormalized when ransomware association is unknown.
limitations: Scores are heuristic prioritization scores, not calibrated probabilities.
CISA KEV records represent known exploited vulnerabilities.
Unknown ransomware association is not a negative label.
Current patch status is not available in the dataset.
Weights and thresholds require further validation.
